build_resnet_with_custom_width: build a ResNet model with a custom width by passing the width parameter to the ResNet constructor
create_model_from_name: create a ResNet model from a name string like imagenet_resnet_50 using Model.get_model_from_name
validate_model_name: validate an ImageNet ResNet model name string using Model.is_valid_model_name static method
get_default_hparams: get the default LotteryDesc hyperparameters for training a ResNet-50 on ImageNet using Model.default_hparams
review_output_layer_names: review the output layer names property to get the fc weight and bias layer names
